name: Light Matki Misal
ingredients: 1 tbsp each ginger-garlic paste and desiccated coconut
1 tbsp misal or goda masala, plus ½ tsp chilli powder
Toppings: 2 tbsp chopped onion, 2 tbsp chopped tomato, 2 tbsp puffed rice (murmura), coriander and lemon
1 whole-wheat pav or slice of bread, halved to share
steps: Heat the oil, then cook the onion, coconut and ginger-garlic paste for 6 minutes. Add the tomato and spices and cook 5 minutes; grind to a paste with a little water.
Cook this paste in the pot for 3 minutes, add the sprouts and 2½ cups water, and simmer for 20 minutes to make a thin curry (kat).
Serve the sprouts and curry in bowls, topped with onion, tomato, puffed rice, coriander and lemon.
Serve with pav or bread on the side.
note: Puffed rice replaces the usual fried sev, and whole-wheat pav adds fibre.
